text:
maria_ops: Heads-up — scheduling a short, surgical maintenance window in az19 tonight 00:15–00:30 UTC. Target: graceful GPU node soft-reboots for 6 nodes in priority-tenant pool (priority-1).

devon_oncall: ack. what's the exact plan for tenant handoff? we need zero 5xx for those customers.

maria_ops: plan is: cordon -> drain nonpriority -> evict priority-1 onto burst pool with QQ pre-warm -> soft-reboot -> uncordon -> KV cache reseed. total per-node ~3–4m, parallelism 2 nodes at once.

kai_sre: confirm burst pool has at least 12 contiguous slots and NVLink locality preserved for large models. If not, fallback to cross-region warmbackfill (eu->az19) which costs more.

maria_ops: burst pool check done: 14 slots available but some are pod-affinity pinned. we'll free 4 by shifting batch sims to evictable nodes.

sam_product: customer comms? any tenants need a heads up? priority-1 set already notified via enterprise-notify. we should post a brief banner too.

nora_support: got flagged tickets for one priority-1 tenant last week about slower cold-starts after KV loss. suggest we run a warm prompt-seed after reseed and verify a couple of eval prompts.

maria_ops: good call. we'll run post-reboot smoke: 3 eval prompts per host within 5m of join. If regressions, rollback plan is immediate drain of that host and route to canary variant m2-quant.

sre-bot: scheduled window created: maintenance-id=maint-az19-2026-03-21-0015, reminders at -30m and -5m. CI job to notify account-ops queued.

devon_oncall: what SLA impact do we expect? need to update the statuspage if p95 latency bump >200ms or error rate >0.5% over baseline.

maria_ops: objective is <50ms p95 delta and <0.1% increase in 5xx. fallback to dedicated overflow region if we see anomalies.

kai_sre: network note — one edge TOR in az19 has transient egress packet-drop at load spikes. We'll lower per-node concurrency during join to 4 to avoid saturating it. add netpol throttle in the join script.

maria_ops: implemented. join script now: `./join.sh --concurrency=4 --kv-reseed-rate=low --post-smoke=true`. pushing to ops-runbook.

sam_product: putting a short banner on console: "Planned infra maintenance (az19) — small interruption to startup times for a subset of enterprise customers; no expected data loss."

nora_support: I'll standby for any priority-1 pings; prepared canned replies.

devon_oncall: reminder: metric watchbook entries: token-emit-rate, p95-gen-latency, 5xx-rate, kv-hit-rate. Alerts set to page if thresholds hit.

maria_ops: all set. will update this thread after the -5m reminder and when window starts. thanks folks :thumbsup:
